sentences.text_target: Mr. Harrison approached the reception desk with a tired expression after his delayed flight.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈmɪstər ˈhærɪsən əˈproʊtʃt ðə rɪˈsɛpʃən dɛsk wɪð ə ˈtaɪərd ɪkˈsprɛʃən ˈæftər hɪz dɪˈleɪd flaɪt/
sentences.text_native: M. Harrison s'est approché de la réception avec l'air fatigué après son vol retardé.

sentences.text_target: The friendly receptionist checked her computer screen to retrieve his online booking.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfrɛndli rɪˈsɛpʃənɪst tʃɛkt hɜːr kəmˈpjuːtər skriːn tuː rɪˈtriːv hɪz ˈɒnˌlaɪn ˈbʊkɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: La réceptionniste sympathique a consulté l'écran de son ordinateur pour retrouver sa réservation en ligne.

sentences.text_target: Unfortunately, the standard room he requested was no longer available.
sentences.phonetic: /ʌnˈfɔːrtʃənətli, ðə ˈstændərd ruːm hiː rɪˈkwɛstɪd wʌz noʊ ˈlɔːŋɡər əˈveɪləbəl/
sentences.text_native: Malheureusement, la chambre standard qu'il avait demandée n'était plus disponible.

sentences.text_target: She decided to apologize sincerely for the slight inconvenience.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː əˈpɒlədʒaɪz sɪnˈsɪrli fɔːr ðə slaɪt ˌɪnkənˈviːniəns/
sentences.text_native: Elle a décidé de s'excuser sincèrement pour ce léger désagrément.

sentences.text_target: According to hotel policy, loyal guests receive special treatment during busy periods.
sentences.phonetic: /əˈkɔːrdɪŋ tuː hoʊˈtɛl ˈpɒlɪsi, ˈlɔɪəl ɡɛsts rɪˈsiːv ˈspɛʃəl ˈtriːtmənt ˈdʊrɪŋ ˈbɪzi ˈpɪriədz/
sentences.text_native: Selon la politique de l'hôtel, les clients fidèles bénéficient d'un traitement spécial pendant les périodes d'affluence.

sentences.text_target: Therefore, she offered him a complimentary upgrade to a luxurious suite.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈðɛrˌfɔːr, ʃiː ˈɒfərd hɪm ə ˌkɒmplɪˈmɛntəri ˈʌpɡreɪd tuː ə lʌɡˈʊriəs swiːt/
sentences.text_native: Par conséquent, elle lui a offert un surclassement gracieux vers une suite luxueuse.

sentences.text_target: The general manager had already authorized this procedure earlier that morning.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdʒɛnərəl ˈmænɪdʒər hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈɔːθəˌraɪzd ðɪs prəˈsiːdʒər ˈɜːrliər ðæt ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Le directeur général avait déjà autorisé cette procédure plus tôt ce matin-là.

sentences.text_target: She processed the new keys very efficiently without keeping him waiting longer.
sentences.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈprɑːsɛst ðə nuː kiːz ˈvɛri ɪˈfɪʃəntli wɪˈaʊt ˈkiːpɪŋ hɪm ˈweɪtɪŋ ˈlɔːŋɡər/
sentences.text_native: Elle a préparé les nouvelles clés très efficacement sans le faire attendre davantage.

sentences.text_target: During the quick handover, she explained all the exclusive facilities.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə kwɪk ˈhændˌoʊvər, ʃiː ɪkˈspleɪnd ɔːl ði ɪkˈskluːsɪv fəˈsɪlətiz/
sentences.text_native: Pendant la brève transition, elle lui a expliqué toutes les installations exclusives.

sentences.text_target: A polite porter immediately took his heavy baggage toward the elevator.
sentences.phonetic: /ə pəˈlaɪt ˈpɔːrtər ɪˈmiːdiətli tʊk hɪz ˈhɛvi ˈbæɡɪdʒ təˈwɔːrd ði ˈɛləveɪtər/
sentences.text_native: Un bagagiste poli a immédiatement pris ses bagages lourds vers l'ascenseur.

sentences.text_target: They rode up to the top floor in comfortable silence.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ roʊd ʌp tuː ðə tɒp flɔːr ɪn ˈkʌmfərtəbəl ˈsaɪləns/
sentences.text_native: Ils sont montés au dernier étage dans un silence confortable.

sentences.text_target: The corridor was quiet, dimly lit, and smelled pleasantly of fresh flowers.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔːrɪdər wʌz ˈkwaɪət, ˈdɪmli lɪt, ænd smɛld ˈplɛzəntli ʌv frɛʃ ˈflaʊərz/
sentences.text_native: Le couloir était calme, tamisé et sentait agréablement les fleurs fraîches.

sentences.text_target: The porter opened the heavy wooden door of room twelve hundred.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɔːrtər ˈoʊpənd ðə ˈhɛvi ˈwʊdən dɔːr ʌv ruːm twɛlv ˈhʌndrəd/
sentences.text_native: Le bagagiste a ouvert la lourde porte en bois de la chambre douze cents.

sentences.text_target: Inside, Mr. Harrison looked around and could not hide his surprise.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɪnˈsaɪd, ˈmɪstər ˈhærɪsən lʊkt əˈraʊnd ænd kʊd nɒt haɪd hɪz sərˈpraɪz/
sentences.text_native: À l'intérieur, M. Harrison a regardé autour de lui et n'a pas pu cacher sa surprise.

sentences.text_target: The living area featured modern furniture and a large screen television.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ ˈɛriə ˈfiːtʃərd ˈmɑːdərn ˈfɜːrnɪtʃər ænd ə lɑːrʒ skriːn ˈtɛlɪˌvɪʒən/
sentences.text_native: Le salon disposait d'un mobilier moderne et d'une télévision grand écran.

sentences.text_target: Through the massive windows, a breathtaking panoramic view of the sea appeared.
sentences.phonetic: /θruː ðə ˈmæsɪv ˈwɪndoʊz, ə ˈbrɛθˌteɪkɪŋ ˌpænəˈræmɪk vjuː ʌv ðə siː əˈpɪrd/
sentences.text_native: À travers les immenses fenêtres, une vue panoramique à couper le souffle sur la mer est apparue.

sentences.text_target: A private balcony offered peaceful spots to relax under the warm sun.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈpraɪvɪt ˈbælkəni ˈɒfərd ˈpiːsfʊl spɒts tuː rɪˈlæks ˈʌndər ðə wɔːrm sʌn/
sentences.text_native: Un balcon privé offrait des endroits paisibles pour se détendre sous le soleil chaud.

sentences.text_target: The marble bathroom included both a deep bathtub and a separate rain shower.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɑːrbəl ˈbæθruːm ɪnˈkluːdɪd boʊθ ə diːp ˈbæθˌtʌb ænd ə ˈsɛpərɪt reɪn ˈʃaʊər/
sentences.text_native: La salle de bains en marbre comprenait à la fois une baignoire profonde et une douche à effet de pluie séparée.

sentences.text_target: Fluffy white towels and premium toiletries rested neatly on the shelf.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈflʌfi waɪt ˈtaʊəlz ænd ˈpriːmiəm ˈtɔɪlɪtriz ˈrɛstɪd ˈniːtli ɒn ðə ʃɛlf/
sentences.text_native: Des serviettes blanches moelleuses et des produits de toilette haut de gamme étaient rangés proprement sur l'étagère.

sentences.text_target: He thanked the helpful porter and generously settled the tip straightaway.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː θæŋkt ðə ˈhɛlpfʊl ˈpɔːrtər ænd ˈdʒɛnərəsli ˈsɛtəld ðə tɪp ˈstreɪtəˌweɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il a remercié le bagagiste serviable et a réglé généreusement le pourboire immédiatement.

sentences.text_target: After unpacking his personal belongings, he decided to explore the hotel restaurant.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈæftər ˌʌnˈpækɪŋ hɪz ˈpɜːrsənəl bɪˈlɒŋɪŋz, hiː dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː ɪkˈsplɔːr ðə hoʊˈtɛl ˈrɛstərənt/
sentences.text_native: Après avoir déballé ses affaires personnelles, il a décidé d'explorer le restaurant de l'hôtel.

sentences.text_target: An attentive waiter showed him to a quiet table near the window.
sentences.phonetic: /ən əˈtɛntɪv ˈweɪtər ʃoʊd hɪm tuː ə ˈkwaɪət ˈteɪbəl nɪr ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
sentences.text_native: Un serveur attentionné l'a conduit à une table calme près de la fenêtre.

sentences.text_target: The evening menu presented an appetizing selection of local specialties.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ˈiːvnɪŋ ˈmɛnjuː ˈprɪzɛntɪd ən ˈæpɪˌtaɪzɪŋ səˈlɛkʃən ʌv ˈloʊkəl ˈspɛʃəltiz/
sentences.text_native: Le menu du soir présentait une sélection appétissante de spécialités locales.

sentences.text_target: He ordered fresh seafood accompanied by a glass of chilled white wine.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈɔːrdərd frɛʃ ˈsiːˌfuːd əˈkʌmpənid baɪ ə ɡlæs ʌv tʃɪld waɪt waɪn/
sentences.text_native: Il a commandé des fruits de mer frais accompagnés d'un verre de vin blanc frais.

sentences.text_target: The peaceful atmosphere allowed him to completely forget his travel fatigue.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈpiːsfʊl ˈætməˌsfɪr əˈlaʊd hɪm tuː kəmˈpliːtli fərˈɡɛt hɪz ˈtrævəl fəˈtiːɡ/
sentences.text_native: L'atmosphère paisible lui a permis d'oublier complètement sa fatigue de voyage.

sentences.text_target: Next morning, a rich breakfast buffet awaited him downstairs.
sentences.phonetic: /nɛkst ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, ə rɪtʃ ˈbrɛkfəst bʊˈfeɪ əˈweɪtɪd hɪm ˈdaʊnˈstɛrz/
sentences.text_native: Le lendemain matin, un riche buffet de petit-déjeuner l'attendait en bas.

sentences.text_target: He enjoyed hot coffee, warm bread, butter, cheese, and fresh fruit juice.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ɪnˈdʒɔɪd hɑːt ˈkɒfi, wɔːrm brɛd, ˈbʌtər, tʃiːz, ænd frɛʃ fruːt dʒuːs/
sentences.text_native: Il a apprécié le café chaud, le pain chaud, le beurre, le fromage et le jus de fruits frais.

sentences.text_target: This wonderful experience far exceeded his initial expectations.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈwʌndərfʊl ɪkˈspɪriəns fɑːr ɪkˈsiːdɪd hɪz ɪˈnɪʃəl ˌɛkspɛkˈteɪʃənz/
sentences.text_native: Cette merveilleuse expérience a largement dépassé ses attentes initiales.

sentences.text_target: He promised himself to return to this magnificent establishment during future trips.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈprɒmɪst hɪmˈsɛlf tuː rɪˈtɜːrn tuː ðɪs mæɡˈnɪfɪsənt ɪˈstæblɪʃmənt ˈdʊrɪŋ ˈfjuːtʃər trɪps/
sentences.text_native: Il s'est promis de revenir dans cet établissement magnifique lors de futurs voyages.

sentences.text_target: Checking out at the end of his stay was smooth and quick.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈtʃɛkɪŋ aʊt æt ði ɛnd ʌv hɪz steɪ wʌz smuːð ænd kwɪk/
sentences.text_native: Le départ à la fin de son séjour s'est déroulé sans encombre et rapidement.
